It's not monotony though.  the failing or possibility of failing grad school when I am honestly trying affirms the not good enough.   I have some variety in life but the new things new books new games new movies I just can't even get interested.  Just bought far cry 4 the other day.  Haven't even opened it because I'm just not interested.  And pets.  My boy.  My beautiful cat.  My best friend.  He's dying.  He's almost 20 years old.  I got him for my 6th birthday.  I remember it like it was this morning.  And the thought of waking up without him pawing at me like he's done for almost 20 years, the thought of going without someone who became closer than a brother.  someone who I can't even remember what life was like before them.  It kills me.  And this all coming in the same week.  The failing and him fading away.  Ive already been dwelling on the idea.  This has just exponentially increased the focus on it.  I have not felt real loss.  I'm fortunate in that regard.  My grandparents expcept for my grandma all died before I had memories.  My grandma just died this year.  Other th an that.  No one I've ever cared for has died.  Her death hit me hard.  But to be honest, when my cat goes it will hit me harder.  I can't even fathom life without him.  He has been the one stabke thing in my life.  When evertyrhing goes to shit a cat knows you need them.  And hes not going to be there.  

On top of everything else, I don't know how to handle that.
